Package org.apache.sysds.runtime.instructions.ooc

Class CachingStream

java.lang.Object
org.apache.sysds.runtime.instructions.ooc.CachingStream
All Implemented Interfaces:
OOCStreamable<IndexedMatrixValue>
public class CachingStream extends Object implements OOCStreamable<IndexedMatrixValue>
A wrapper around LocalTaskQueue to consume the source stream and reset to consume again for other operators.
